items.prompt: Why evaluate node stock as S*exp((2*j-i)*sigma*sqrt(dt)) rather than multiply two separately huge reciprocal powers?

options.text: It changes the tree into a deterministic constant stock.
options.why: The exponent still depends on the up-count and level.

options.text: It avoids overflow in competing factors before they multiply.
options.why: The identity uses one bounded log-factor under the stated domain, while rounding paths may differ.

options.text: It guarantees bitwise identity with every pow implementation.
options.why: Algebraic equivalence does not guarantee identical floating intermediates.

options.text: It proves the volatility parameter is physically correct.
options.why: Numerical evaluation does not validate the market model.

items.explanation: The identity uses one bounded log-factor under the stated domain, while rounding paths may differ.
